action.description: `read` returns the current memory (or one note); `edit` applies `ops`

note.description: For `read`: the note slug to show instead of the entry files

ops.description: For `edit`: applied in order, all or nothing

match.description: replace/remove: a substring that identifies exactly one entry

text.description: add/replace: the entry; write_note: the note body

note.description: write_note/delete_note: slug, lowercase letters, digits and dashes

description.description: write_note: one line shown in the index
